title: Taking a taxi in English: 8 phrases, a real conversation and speaking practice | English Routine
description:
Taking a taxi — ركوب تاكسي
A full lesson for everyday American English, with Arabic help: 8 words and phrases, a real conversation, 3 listening questions, then your turn to speak.
درس كامل: ٨ كلمات بمعناها بالعربي، الحوار، ٣ أسئلة، وبعدين دورك تتكلم بصوتك.

Chapters
0:00 8 words
0:42 The conversation
1:12 3 questions
1:38 Your turn: speak
2:25 Good to know

Words
• pick me up = يعدّي عليّا ياخدني
• drop me off = ينزّلني
• how long does it take? = بتاخد قد إيه؟
• traffic = زحمة مرور
• in a hurry = مستعجل
• keep the change = خلّي الباقي
• fare = الأجرة
• pull over = يركن على جنب
